assembled_by.route: expert recall — named from the author's own knowledge of the literature, then each item existence-checked
assembled_by.why: v3 IS the general-web-search route, so the control may not be assembled by general web search (it would measure the protocol against itself). It may not be assembled by OpenAlex queries either, since those are v1/v2. A third route is required, and recall is the one available.

declared_limits: Expert recall is bounded by what the author happens to know; it is biased toward well-known items and cannot include anything the author never read.

Existence-checking each item against an index does not make the index the assembly route, but it does mean every control item is index-visible — so the control cannot penalise a protocol for missing index-invisible work.
n=6 gives a weak lower bound on recall even at a perfect score (TARGET_SELECTION §11.2).
The class 'a validity review that exists and nobody named and no index surfaced' is absent by definition, so any measured recall is an UPPER bound (TARGET_SELECTION §17).
